verdict.rationale: Letta offers cross-interface persistence (desktop, CLI, web, messaging integrations) and an OpenAI-compatible/ACP-compatible App Server that lets external clients like Open WebUI or Zed connect to the same agent, plus MCP-client support for tool connections. But there's no documented direct integration path for Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor specifically to share the same memory store — the evidence shows generic API compatibility and third-party MCP servers rather than named off-the-shelf assistant integrations. Missing for 10: explicit first-party integration guides for Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor consuming the same Letta memory, and independent confirmation that these named tools actually share state via Letta in practice.
